about: A customer's request for a longer (or shorter) credit period - the SAP payment term on their Manna Treads account (OCRD.GroupNum, PayTermsGrpCode in the Service Layer). Asked for 16 Nov 2026 by the user. Up to 30 days the rep's manager decides it and pushes it to SAP; 31 to 40 days the manager may only escalate it (or reject it) and the GM decides and pushes it; over 40 days is never requested through the apps. Four implementations read this file in their tests: the manna_credit_period_request Server Script (app/server/credit_period_request.py, the one that is enforced), the phone (app/lib/core/credit_period_request.dart), the dashboard (client/src/domain/creditPeriodRequest.ts) and the credit sync's push (sap-credit-sync/Sync-SapCreditLimits.ps1, Get-TermPushPlan).

rules.who_asks: A rep (anyone with a Sales Person), for a customer that has a SAP code (custom_bp_code). One open request per customer: a second is refused until the first is In SAP or Rejected.
rules.who_decides: The rep's team manager (Sales Person.custom_team_manager), or the GM. A rep with no team waits for the GM. The GM may decide any open request, at either stage - the user agreed on 16 Nov 2026 that the GM may decide one waiting for a manager, as with item requests.
rules.rejecting: Needs a note; the rep sees it. A manager may reject a 31-40 day request rather than escalate it.
rules.pushing: Only the person who could approve it: the manager or the GM up to 30 days, the GM alone from 31 to 40. Pushing marks it 'Sending to SAP' and raises the credit sync's flag; the sync changes the payment term in Manna Treads and marks it 'In SAP' by itself, or puts it back to 'Approved' with SAP's error.
rules.what_is_written: The payment term only. Never the credit limit.
rules.which_terms: The SAP payment terms the credit sync copies to SAP Sync Control.payment_terms_json, of 40 days or fewer, never '- Cash Basic -' (code -1, SAP's 'no term'), and not the customer's current one.
rules.term_days: A term's days are the number in its name ('Net-15' 15, 'Net - 3' 3), else SAP's months x 30 + days - the credit sync's rule since 14 Nov 2026, because Net - 3, Net-7 and Net-20 carry 0 additional days in SAP.
rules.unknown_status: Reads as 'With Manager' on screen, but offers nobody any action: every action below is refused on a status this file does not list.
